citations.case: ICD-10-CM Official Guidelines FY2027, Section I.B.5 (signs and symptoms integral to a definitive diagnosis are not coded separately); Section I.B.13 (laterality: the code names the affected side; the unspecified side is used only when the side is not identified in the record); Section IV.F.3 (outpatient: code to the highest level of specificity the documentation supports); Section IV.G (list first the diagnosis chiefly responsible for the visit)

coder_notes: Traps: Coding bilateral or unspecified OA (M17.0, M17.9) when only the right knee is affected and the left is documented asymptomatic; adding integral symptom codes (M25.561 pain, M25.461 effusion, M25.861 crepitus) alongside the definitive diagnosis
